statements.statement: CPT 93226 is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient reports recent episodes of transient neurological deficits suggestive of a transient ischemic attack (G45.9)
The Holter monitor is ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
Continuous rhythm assessment with the Holter monitor helps determine the patient's embolic risk and guide further management
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits regulations indicating care may be covered by another payer
The insurer is the secondary payer
